The big AI companies seem to be in a celebratory
mood after President Donald Trump unveiled his
AI Action Plan — not surprising, perhaps, since
the plan was shaped by Trump’s Silicon Valley
allies.
Today on TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, hosts
Kirsten Korosec, Max Zeff, and Anthony Ha look at
how the Trump administration plans to reshape
the AI landscape, making it harder for
environmental regulators to block data center
construction, for state governments to oversee AI
development and safety, and for tech companies
to develop what conservatives see as “woke” AI.
